mission.title: Under Warranty
mission.description: Escort a repair program to a renegade hacker nexus.

phase.briefing: Operative, the renegade Morpheus and his followers have been disrupting the code of the Matrix to create artificial information nexus areas where their hackers can access data. We have, of course, been able to track these sites. You will escort our repair program to one of these sites and protect it while it repairs the damage.

enter.say: The repair program, Stewart The Mechanic, is inside. Escort him outside and I will update you with the location of your target.

objective.text: Lead Stewart The Mechanic out of the building
Do not allow Stewart The Mechanic to be incapacitated

phase.briefing: Your waypoint is being updated with the location of the renegade hacker nexus now. Get Stewart The Mechanic there safely.

enter.say: Morpheus' hacker site is inside that building. There appears to be a large concentration of Exile programs in the area. Wipe them out and get Stewart The Mechanic to the active computer inside the hacker nexus.
You're close to the active renegade computer system. The far door is locked--if you can't open it yourself, you'll have to look around for a key.

objective.text: Find the key to the far door

done.say: There's the active system. Lead Stewart The Mechanic up to it so that it can begin to repair the damage made by Morpheus' flunkies.

objective.text: Lead Stewart The Mechanic to the active computer

done.say: Repair program initiated. Exile reinforcements detected. Destroy them, operative.

objective.text: Do not allow Stewart The Mechanic to be incapacitated

done.say: Those Exile vermin deserved a somewhat slower deletion.

complete.say: That's it, {player}. You can get out of there now.

mission.finish: Those Exiles endangered our mission. We will deal with them after we have finished with Morpheus.
